b: TORONTO — Diversified acquired MDBriefCase Group Inc. (“MDBriefCase”) from Think Research Corporation.
MDBriefCase was founded in 2001 and is one of Canada’s largest healthcare professional networks and a leading digital provider of continuing medical education and professional development (CME/CPD).
This move pairs MDBriefCase’s portfolio with Diversified Canada’s Pri-Med portfolio of accredited CME/CPD for primary care and is Diversified’s fourth acquisition of 2026.
Oakley Dyer, Chief Corporate Development Officer at Diversified

“Our Pri-Med business in Canada serves many of the same healthcare professionals as MDBriefCase, making this a natural fit,” Oakley Dyer, Chief Corporate Development Officer at Diversified, said. “MDBriefCase significantly expands our digital medical education capabilities while allowing us to reach new audiences in oncology and pharmacy education.”
Diversified has operated in Canada for many years, with a local leadership team that understands the market and has developed strong relationships within the industries it serves.

“We recognize that each of our global markets is unique and rely on our local teams to guide business decisions. This acquisition is a reflection of our confidence in the Canadian market and our long-term commitment to doing business there,” Dyer said. “By combining MDBriefCase’s on-demand learning capabilities with Pri-Med’s conferences and virtual programs, we can better serve healthcare professionals throughout the year while creating new opportunities for our education partners.”
Diversified plans to continue investing in MDBriefCase’s digital platforms while bringing its experience in producing live medical education events to the business.
“There is a great deal of expertise within both teams, and we see opportunities to learn from one another and build on what has already made these businesses successful,” Dyer explained.
Diversified will continue to actively pursue acquisition opportunities across its global divisions.

“As a family-owned company, we take a long-term view of growth and look for businesses that complement our existing portfolios and where we believe Diversified can make a meaningful contribution,” Dyer said.
